title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a laptop screen. Intracranial EEG from 1103 contacts covering cortical and subcortical structures was recorded simultaneously with the participants' pitch-shifted speech audio. The dataset supports research on speech production and speech decoding for brain-computer interfaces, and includes electrode localisation and FreeSurfer derivatives.
methods_description: Dixi Medical Microdeep sEEG shafts were recorded with Micromed SD LTM amplifiers at 1024 or 2048 Hz, with data downsampled to 1024 Hz. Audio was captured with a notebook microphone at 48 kHz and pitch-shifted for anonymity. Neural, audio and stimulus streams were synchronised with LabStreamingLayer. Electrodes were localised by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT using img_pipe, with Destrieux atlas labels. Participants read each word aloud during a 2 s presentation followed by a 1 s fixation cross.
